messages.subject: accessing elements of Eigen types
parts:
As explained here

http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/QuickRefPage.html

in the section on Basic Matrix Manipulation of Eigen types,

y[i] // checks to make sure i is not outside range
y(i) // checks range unless NDEBUG is defined
y(i,j) // checks range unless NDEBUG is defined

Our makefile passes -DNDEBUG, but you can take that out temporarily to
check whether a new function has range errors. And we should probably
have Jenkins not pass -DNDEBUG ever.

But the big problem is that there are a ton of instances in stan's C++
files that use the bracket notation, meaning that we waste wall time
range checking every little thing. I grepped 547 instances, but some
of those are false positives. We probably should fix all of them.

Ben
